system.description:
Hobby/Professional/Expert Ability is a catch-all for areas of skill not covered by another Ability — a trade picked up on the side or a specifically studied topic. It embraces highly unusual fields such as Cainite Lore, Thanatology or Demolitions.

Any Ability of this type must be specifically approved by the Storyteller, who defines its exact capabilities and applications in play.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
